name: ARC-315E Portable IGBT MMA Welder 160A

images.alt: GOWELLDE ARC-315E portable IGBT MMA welding machine

summary: 4.1 kg portable stick welder for site repair and light fabrication. Our best-selling entry model.
description: The ARC-315E is the mainstream choice for basic stick welding. At only 4.1 kg it moves easily between workshops, rooftops and remote sites, while the IGBT inverter stage keeps the arc stable on long extension cables and generator power. Handles complex joints and narrow spaces where heavier machines cannot reach.
features: IGBT inverter technology, high power-to-weight ratio
Hot start & anti-stick for easy rod striking
